company.name: Co-Own
company.shortDescription: Co‑Own is a real estate investment platform.
company.description:
Co‑Own is a real estate investment platform based in the United Arab Emirates that enables individuals to co-invest in residential properties through fractional ownership. The platform allows multiple investors to collectively purchase and own shares of a property, lowering the capital required to enter the real estate market.

Co-Own manages the investment process by sourcing properties, structuring the ownership model, and handling property management, maintenance, and rental operations. Investors can earn returns through rental income and potential property value appreciation while holding a proportional share of the asset.
